messages:
sofia: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A on release gates, oncall escalation, and SLAs. Two things leadership asked for: a clear freeze/blackout policy and an escalation matrix for Dedicated customers. Where should we put the canonical version?

anjali: I can own the freeze policy doc. Proposal: two-week soft freeze before major feature launches, 72h hard blackout for infra changes. Soft freeze means no non-essential migrations; hard blackout = no infra-level deploys.

sam: agree on the windows. Need to spell out exceptions (security fixes, GDPR patches). Also suggest we add a short regression sashimi: top-10 regressions must be green before release.

lee: where will this live? my vote: engops repo -> release-policies/blackout.md and link from the all-hands notes. I'll PR it once we agree.

rafa: for Dedicated SLAs, customers often want "round-the-clock" support. We should add an escalation matrix with SLO thresholds + contact sequence. Something like:
1) pager -> primary oncall (15m)
2) if no ack -> page infra SME (10m)
3) if still unresolved -> page leadership/CS (30m)

sofia: Good structure. Also leadership requested clarity on what counts as "critical" for SLO burn. Can we define severity levels tied to error budget consumption?

anjali: draft mapping:
- Sev1: customer-visible outage (>10% traffic impacted OR >5min order of magnitude error rate) -> immediate page + incident bridge
- Sev2: degraded performance (p99 latency > 2x baseline for >15m) -> oncall triage, elevated paging if no progress
- Sev3: minor regressions, nonblocking errors -> create ticket, normal SLAs apply

sam: procedural ask: every Sev1 must have a postmortem within 72 hours and a follow-up with action owners. If it affects Dedicated customers, mark as P0 for CS.

lee: small ops note: add a pre-release checklist that CI must satisfy for Dedicated launches. Example snippet: 
```
release_checks:
  - integration_e2e: pass
  - perf_baseline_exported: true
  - smoke_p99 < 1.2 * baseline
  - infra_migrations_allowed: false (during blackout)
```
If any check fails, block the release.

rafa: who owns the contact list for Dedicated customers? We need a directory with oncall contacts, primary/backup, and escalations. Maybe a yaml under engops so automation can read it.

oncall-bot: Reminder: weekly oncall sync tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Rotate reminder sent to #eng-oncall.

sofia: Action items:
- anjali: draft blackout policy + severity mapping (due 5 business days).
- lee: create engops doc and PR with pre-release checklist (due EOD Fri).
- sam: update postmortem policy for Sev1 (72h window) and add Dedicated tagging requirement (due next Tue).
- rafa: create Dedicated contact dir proposal (yaml) and share for review (due 1 week).

anjali: one more Q for product folks 60; how strict are we on feature freeze for PMs? PMs: please confirm in the PM checklist whether deprecations/migrations are allowed during soft freeze.

sofia: I'll ping product leads. Thanks all 44d. I'll post a summary to #all-hands and link the PRs when ready.
